name: frasalvi-project-oversight
description: Marketplace for my custom set of plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: team-development
plugins.description: Plan execution with persistent agent-team workers — domain-scoped teammates, ask-don't-guess escalation, and right-sized reviews. Companion to superpowers.

plugins.name: fork-development
plugins.description: Plan execution with forked implementer subagents that inherit the session's design context and prompt cache, gated by sparse fresh reviews. Companion to superpowers.

plugins.name: research-companion
plugins.description: Strategic research thinking agents — idea evaluation, project triage, and structured brainstorming inspired by Carlini's research methodology

plugins.name: project-oversight
plugins.description: Roadmap oversight: cut a project into steps that each carry their own open questions, weighted Full, Light or Paired, scope later steps lazily, and revise the roadmap as work lands.

plugins.name: pr-review-triage
plugins.description: Triage PR review comments inline: verify each bot claim against the code and how the project actually runs, fix what's real, dismiss the rest with evidence, then merge and clean up.
